evidence.summary: 为DSH项目持久保存任务、文档、代码符号与经验，支持检索和自动上下文注入。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、package.json、src/index.js、src/setup/taskbridge.js、src/tools/query-memory.js、src/auto-inject.js、src/store.js；项目任务与多层记忆通过根归属、查询和可选注入连接；task/global可见性和预算独立处理。见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
limitations: 检查固定入口、TaskBridge、query_memory、auto-inject通道和store锁/flush；未逐项覆盖全部解析器、UI、向量实现与真实大项目。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 适合跨会话开发同一项目并愿意维护记忆的人；合格结果是准确回源和续接任务。人工笔记及grep对照见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
项目任务与多层记忆通过根归属、查询和可选注入连接；task/global可见性和预算独立处理。见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
检查固定入口、TaskBridge、query_memory、auto-inject通道和store锁/flush；未逐项覆盖全部解析器、UI、向量实现与真实大项目。
固定package明确npm名称与可选leanvec/宿主依赖；发布字节与运行兼容未验收。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 索引磁盘、解析器/可选向量表 | 确认根、范围和全局层 | 大项目首建资源未知 |
| 持续使用 | I/O、内存、注入上下文；可选LLM扩展 | 审核经验、回源和删除过期内容 | 总调用及纠错时间未知 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试写入/重建索引 | 检查目录锁、脏状态和落盘 | 崩溃/并发恢复未实测 |
| 迁移退出 | 项目及global存储备份 | 明确范围再禁用/迁移 | 未验收退出与数据迁移 |
建议单一非敏感工程小范围试用，先按需查询和回源，后逐步开启自动注入；串项目和未落盘等停止标准见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 任务续接 | 持久任务与todo接管 | 实际减少重新定界时间 |
| 多层召回 | 限根、task/global和可选扩展 | 当前事实正确率与遗漏 |
| 自动记忆使用 | trigger/提示通道与预算 | 对最终任务的净收益 |
分层职责、跨进程锁和显式持久化状态可复用；跨项目可见性、事件归属与经验时效需要持续管理。见 [Q03](#research-q03) 与 [Q05](#research-q05)。
从静态笔记扩展为任务绑定、索引和经验召回组合，减少重新组织入口的潜在负担，但不保证减少错误。见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
相关性命中不证明条目仍正确，global可见性和模型看不到source元数据要求更强回源；内存更新也不能替代成功落盘。见 [Q03](#research-q03)。
未验证假设为在经验召回后核对当前代码约束与时效，显式标注冲突；三组任务对照与否定条件见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: novelty 50%档，相对笔记与基础检索组合任务桥及触发注入，非新embedding算法；mechanism 50%档，来源/通道/预算改变注入取舍，真实性未保证；transferability 50%档，分层记忆和锁设计可复用，宿主事件需适配；simplification 50%档，读时记忆与任务接管减少手工组织，但全局治理复杂。

business.rationale: workflow 50%档，跨会话任务交接更结构化，效果未知；delivery 50%档，形成带出处的项目续接资料而非纯聊天；reach 25%档，默认本地和词法回退降低基础设施门槛，学习负担仍在；economics 25%档，可能减少重读但注入和纠错有成本，无净节省实测。

recommendation.reason: 项目续接和可回源记忆有明确价值，可单项目控制范围；需审阅自动注入、global可见性和真实落盘，不把召回分数当事实。

scenario.rationale: 跨会话同项目开发需求明确。

advantage.rationale: 任务/文件与多层召回比人工笔记有具体接线增量。

evidence.rationale: 只固定源码，无宿主或最终任务对照。

cost.rationale: 本地存储简化服务部署，索引/注入/纠错治理负担仍明显。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| TaskBridge与任务管理 | 跨会话续接步骤和文件 | 依赖项目根与会话事件 |
| 文档/代码索引 | 建立可回源项目材料 | 解析范围和文件时效需核对 |
| query_memory | 召回事实/经验/任务 | global层跨项目可见，得分非正确性 |
| 自动注入 | 在触发时加入上下文 | 内容需审阅，预算和来源提示有限 |
| 记忆存储 | 保存任务与经验 | 锁超时仍可能pending |

研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核对项目记忆的任务/召回/注入链路，区分可追溯机制与真实任务收益。 ### Q01 · 项目记忆相对AGENTS和人工任务记录增加什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 目标是跨会话反复进入同一代码项目、需要继续任务及过去决策的开发者。合格交付是准确找回相关事实与出处、当前任务步骤和文件，再回源核对，而不是索引更多条目。相对人工AGENTS/任务笔记，插件将宿主todo和文件事件转成持久任务，并按文档、符号、经验与分层insight检索；相对普通全文grep，增加任务绑定、经验召回和按需注入。作者报告的节省和“避免重犯”尚需同任务效果对照，词法/向量得分不是事实正确性证明。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:10-27](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/f5aa9dcfd815edf4256e619648e9455889b316a7/README.md#L10-L27) 作者列出项目开发记忆和多层能力。
查看原文（18行） ```text A persistent **project development memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents. Built specifically for project development, natively integrated with dsh's task system: task lists and files read during a session are automatically persisted as cross-session task records, with tasks ↔ files linked — workflows can be switched and resumed, no need to re-scope the whole project, solving context loss. Documents (PDF/Markdown/txt) and code symbols are stored separately per workspace; documents are automatically cross-linked to the code symbols they mention. Experience notes (problem → solution) are automatically deduplicated, preventing repeated mistakes. All data is stored per project on disk, survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citations for source verification. No native builds, no vector database. A 79 MB local embedding table (`leanvec`) installs and runs by default; without it, recall falls back to pure lexical. > The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete file and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project. ![Task panel: task list, step progress, and involved files](docs/images/image.png) ## Features - **TaskBridge: cross-session development tasks** — the session's todo list and the files it touches are persisted as per-project task entities, so a workflow can be switched and resumed without re-scoping the project. Associated files stay in recency-weighted order (a read never outranks a written file), so a resumed session sees where to look first. New sessions continue with `list_tasks` → `select_task`. Work delegated to subagents creates no task. On hosts without session events the task tools still work as a plain record list. - **Task panel and editing** — draggable cards show a task's steps and files, and can collapse to a mini-bar or be hidden. Title, steps and status can be edited inline, writing back through the same path as model updates; four visual themes change material, geometry, typeface and density only, and colours follow the host. The panel stays hidden until summoned, syncs in the background on session switch, never reopens itself after a refresh, and a render failure cannot take down the host. - **Document memory** — PDF, Markdown and plain text are chunked and summarized without a model call. Each entry keeps a short summary for injection, a bounded term set for recall, and a citation back to the source. - **Code symbol memory** — a dependency-free scanner extracts functions, classes, methods, interfaces and type aliases with full signatures across 8 languages. Where `typescript` is installed, an optional second layer adds inferred return types, generics and interface shapes; it runs in the background and never blocks indexing. - **Automatic, read-time memorization** — a file is memorized the moment the model reads it, so memory is a byproduct of normal work rather than an upfront scan, and files nobody reads are never indexed. A background poll re-memorizes changed files only. - **Doc ↔ code cross-linking** — a document that mentions a symbol is surfaced when that symbol is queried. Links are resolved against the current symbol table, so they cannot go stale. - **Hybrid recall** — ranked search over documents, symbols, experience notes and insights, with optional LLM query expansion. The experience/insight layers are re-ordered by cosine when `leanvec` is present — installed by default, absent ⇒ pure lexical. Tuned for CJK: phrase boost, a synonym table, and CJK-aware boundaries for doc↔symbol linking. - **Experience notes** — problems → solutions, deduplicated by overlap rather than repeated, bounded by project size, and surfaced both by search and by the same injection path as lessons. - **Tiered insight memory (lessons / decisions / procedures)** — one entity across task, project and global scope. Near-duplicates merge or reinforce, and promotion moves an entry between scopes instead of copying it. Use is recorded, so decay and capacity rank by activity rather than age alone. The panel exposes a per-scope view for reviewing and editing entries. That list is ordered newest-first and loaded incrementally: 30 entries at a time, with the next page prefetched before the reader reaches the bottom and off-screen rows skipped by the renderer, so a large memory stays responsive. - **Triggered injection** — an insight may carry an authored trigger: only `when` triggers, `guard` narrows it, and `prevents` records what breaks without the entry. Corpus text can never trigger an injection; the statistical channel is gated separately and silent by default. **Evidence is graded by source**: only host facts (structured tool calls, `fs`/`todo` events) and irreversible actions named by the human (commit / publish / release / push / deploy / go public) can inject full text; prose mentions of delete / clean up / render / benchmark only feed the hint channel, and subagent prompts plus notice-shaped messages never count as actions — in one real session they produced 72% of all injected characters. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.js:202-247](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/f5aa9dcfd815edf4256e619648e9455889b316a7/src/index.js#L202-L247) 任务、索引、召回、经验及注入入口实际注册。
查看原文（46行） ```text // TaskBridge：任务实体 + 宿主 todo 同步 setupTaskbridge(ctx, config) // 用法本身也是记忆的一部分：注册成宿主 skill（可选依赖，没有 skills 服务就静默跳过）。 setupSkill(ctx) // 跟踪会话路由（request/header 事件），为无会话上下文的召回期可选 LLM（查询扩展 / 反思）兜底 ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => { if (event?.type === 'request/header') rememberRoute(session) // 会话活跃信号：有人正在跑回合时把 watch 轮询压到最低，回合结束立刻补扫一次（见 watch.js）。 // 这是"轮询只在空闲时发生"的落点 —— 交互期间把 I/O 全让给模型，停下那一刻才整理索引。 const key = session?.id ?? 'unknown' if (event?.type === 'turn/start' || event?.type === 'step/start') watchManager.setSessionActive(key, true) else if (event?.type === 'turn/end') watchManager.setSessionActive(key, false) }) // 会话被销毁时也要摘掉活跃标记：否则一个没有正常 turn/end 的会话会把轮询**永久**压在兜底节拍 // （不会卡死，但"空闲时高速刷新"再也不会回来）。 ctx.on('session/disposed', (session) => { watchManager.setSessionActive(session?.id ??
